get.summary:
lncli: `offer list`
ListOffers lists the offers this node has minted, newest first.

parameters.name: active_only
parameters.description: List only offers that are enabled.

post.summary:
lncli: `offer create`
CreateOffer mints a BOLT 12 offer for this node's chain and stores it. The
node answers invoice requests for it over onion messages for as long as
it is active and unexpired.

lncli: `offer decode`
DecodeBolt12 decodes an offer (lno1...), invoice request (lnr1...) or
invoice (lni1...) and reports which chain it names.

lncli: `offer disable`
DisableOffer stops the node from serving an offer. The offer stays listed
and can be enabled again.

lncli: `offer enable`
EnableOffer resumes serving a disabled offer.

description.description:
The offer's description, shown to the payer. Required when an amount
is set. A mining pool that pays over BOLT 12 mandates its own text
here, for example "OCEAN Payouts for <bitcoin address>".

amount_msat.description:
The amount the offer asks for, in millisatoshi. Zero lets the payer
choose the amount, which is what a pool payout needs.

absolute_expiry.description:
When the offer stops being valid, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Zero
means it does not expire.

issuer.description: Free text naming who is being paid.

quantity_max.description:
The largest quantity a request may ask for. Zero leaves quantities
out of the offer unless quantity_any is set.

label.description: A note kept with the offer on this node only.

with_paths.description:
Put blinded paths on the offer even though the node announces an
address. Blinded paths hide the node id and let an unannounced node
be reached; they also make the offer string longer.

no_paths.description:
Never put blinded paths on the offer, even when the node announces no
address. Payers must then reach the node by its id.

quantity_any.description: Let a request ask for any quantity. Excludes quantity_max.

created.description:
Whether the offer was minted now. The same fields always mint the same
offer, so minting it again returns the stored offer with this false.

bolt12.description: An offer, invoice request or invoice string.

for_this_chain.description:
Whether the message names this node's chain, read from its chain
fields alone. A message for another chain still decodes, so its chain
can be shown.

chains.description:
The chains the message names. Empty means it names none, which BOLT 12
reads as Bitcoin mainnet.

offer_id.description: The id of the offer the message is or mirrors, if it has one.

offer.description:
The offer's fields, for an offer, or the mirrored offer fields for a
request or invoice.

invoice_request.description: The request's own fields, for an invoice request or an invoice.

invoice.description: The invoice's own fields, for an invoice.

valid.description:
For an offer: whether it passes the reader checks for this chain and
the current time. A request or invoice is not validated here, since
that needs the offer it answers.

validation_error.description: Why the offer is not valid, when it is not.

ours.description: Whether this node minted the offer.

offer_id.description: The id of the offer to disable.
The id of the offer to enable.

payment_hash.description: The payment hash to pay to.

node_id.description: The node id that signed the invoice, invoice_node_id.

created_at.description: When the invoice was created, as a Unix timestamp.

relative_expiry.description: How long the invoice is valid after created_at, in seconds.

num_paths.description: How many blinded payment paths the invoice carries.

payer_id.description: The payer's key the invoice answers, invreq_payer_id.

signature_valid.description: Whether the invoice carries a valid signature by node_id.

payer_id.description: The payer's key for this request, invreq_payer_id.

amount_msat.description: The amount requested in millisatoshi, if the request sets one.

quantity.description: The quantity requested, if the request sets one.

signature_valid.description:
Whether the request carries a valid signature by payer_id. Always
false for the request fields mirrored in an invoice, which carries the
issuer's signature instead.

offer_id.description: The offer id: the BOLT 12 Merkle root of the offer's fields.

bolt12.description: The offer as a bech32 string, lno1..., to hand to payers.

amount_msat.description: The amount the offer asks for in millisatoshi, or zero for any.

absolute_expiry.description: When the offer expires as a Unix timestamp, or zero for never.

created_at.description:
When this node minted the offer, as a Unix timestamp. Zero for an
offer this node did not mint.

active.description:
Whether this node serves the offer. False for a disabled offer, and
for an offer this node did not mint.

invoices_issued.description: How many invoices this node has issued for the offer.

label.description: The operator's note, kept on this node only.

issuer_id.description:
The node id that signs the offer's invoices, offer_issuer_id, if the
offer names one.

num_paths.description: How many blinded paths the offer carries.

chains.description:
The chains the offer names. An offer that names none is for Bitcoin
mainnet, which is not this node's chain.

issuer.description: Free text naming who is being paid, offer_issuer, if any.

quantity_max.description:
The largest quantity a request may ask for, if the offer sets one.
Zero with quantity_any set means any quantity.

quantity_any.description: Whether a request may ask for any quantity.
